description: Read the content of one item of a library entry's latest version. `agent`, `skill` and `mcp-server` need `itemId` (from library_get, or a merge preview's `libraryItemId`); `file` needs `path`; `skill-file` needs `itemId` (the skill) and `path`, returns `{path, content}` and refuses a binary file; `rules` needs neither. Any other combination is refused. Items are not addressed by name: names are not unique inside an entry. `entry` is the entry's exact name (matched case-insensitively, surrounding spaces ignored), or its id with `byId: true`; a value that looks like an id is still taken as a name without `byId`.

byId.description: `entry` is an entry id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

entry.description: Library entry name, or its id with byId.

path.description: Path of the plugin file, or of the file inside the skill.

name: library_item
title: Get library entry item
